parameters.apprise_url_plus: smtp2go://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.user_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.host_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }/
parameters.description:
`msg-to-smtp2go-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SMTP2Go destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional SMTP2Go destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SMTP2GO destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to SMTP2GO v3 email/send
parameters.summary: Send an email to your own SMTP2Go destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SMTP2Go apikey

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SMTP2Go host

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SMTP2Go user
